ARABIC LANGUAGE — TERMLY EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Imitative Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Imitative Speaking.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Imitative Speaking.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Imitative Speaking.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Imitative Speaking.

2. When practising Conversational Skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Conversational Skills.

   C. Copy random text without understanding Conversational Skills.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Conversational Skills.

   D. Copy random text without understanding Public Speaking.

5. When practising Phonological Awareness: Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   D. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive Speaking.

7. When practising Listening for Gist: Attentive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Gist: Attentive Listening.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Gist: Attentive Listening.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Gist: Attentive Listening.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Gist: Attentive Listening.

8. In ARABIC LANGUAGE, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Mix random languages with no purpose
   B. Avoid speaking to classmates
   C. Only memorise without using the language
   D. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day

9. When practising Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation, which approach is best? (1 mark)

----
